AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.

19. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

20. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.

22. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Agroforestry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Pest control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Production Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Digestive systems of animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Parasite control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Structures in Animal production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Selected Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
